title: Editor E0 task 12b, Spotlight editor slice: the Spotlight editor and its console preview run on the node store behind the switch
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-20. app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/manage/spotlight/page.tsx reads renderPathEnabled('spotlight'); on, it seeds the builder with the Spotlight as nodes (spaceSpotlightNodes) and draws the preview with LiveNodeGrid. SpaceSpotlightEditor mounts a NodeLayoutProvider that saves through saveSpaceSpotlightLayout and the NodeLinkListBuilder when the seed carries a node layout, else the legacy provider and EntityPageBuilder unchanged. Honest gap: the public Spotlight (app/spaces/[slug]/spotlight) and the website Spotlight still read the type-keyed projection, which is empty for a native document, so render_path_spotlight must stay off until LIVE-1055.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const rd=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const bad=[];const e=rd('components/spotlight/space-spotlight-editor.tsx');if(!e.includes('NodeLinkListBuilder')||!e.includes('NodeLayoutProvider'))bad.push('editor has no node path');if(!e.includes('EntityLayoutProvider'))bad.push('legacy path lost');if(!rd('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/manage/spotlight/page.tsx').includes(\"renderPathEnabled('spotlight')\"))bad.push('page ignores the switch');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1054: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Spotlight editor loses its node path or its legacy path, or the console page stops following render_path_spotlight. Behavior is space-spotlight-editor.test.tsx.
